name: Zombie Break
overview: A glamorous drama launch event turns into a nightmare when a virus-contaminated drink sparks a deadly zombie outbreak. As the infection spreads through a small Thai city, the government seals off the area, trapping the remaining survivors inside. Forced to rely on one another, three couples must battle the relentless undead, heartbreaking losses, and impossible choices in a desperate fight for survival. Amid the chaos, they discover that love may be the only thing powerful enough to keep their humanity alive.
